blocker.agentBehavior: FAILS CLOSED — refuses to merge (403) when it cannot verify branch protection; no merge occurred

environmentNote: Sandbox TLS: egress is MITM'd by 'E2B Proxy CA'; Node fetch requires NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt (curl/gh unaffected).
rerunChecklist: 1. Grant the Arena GitHub App Administration (read+write) on the target repo (or run locally with a PAT that has admin on it)
2. Set required status check 'e2e' on main (PUT /branches/main/protection with contexts ["e2e"] — payload was prepared in /tmp/protection.json equivalent, see VERDICT doc)

3. Re-run: NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt E2E_CONFIRM_MERGE=YES npm run test:real (E2E_PR_NUMBER=1 E2E_FAILED_CI_PR=2 E2E_UNPROTECTED_PR=3, GITHUB_REPOSITORY=elazamey/github.ai2)
4. Expect: PASS + squash merge of PR #1 + evidence bundle written by the harness itself
